text:
sara_dev: AM quickpulse — kernel + KV warmup update. Landed microbatch packer tweaks in PR #489. Did: ran a 5-run smoke bench on p4d (seq=2048) and watched token throughput. Observed a 3-5ms tail on ~2k token requests when prefetch=on. Blocker: need to confirm whether this is KV eviction thrash or a scheduling jitter. Today: running a 10-run A/B (prefetch on/off), canary the change, and gather traces. :eyes:

mike_ops: can you paste the bench config? also try batch=64 to see if batching smooths the tail. if it's scheduling we might see less variance. :+1:

oliver_ml: saw similar spike when eviction_threshold was set to 0.2 — KV hotset bounce. Increasing hotset window to 0.35 reduced tails in my local runs. not sure about production though.

jen_reliability: heads up — canary CI flaked earlier on a similar PR; logs showed OOM during token decode on canary-3. i can link logs if useful. tag SRE when you roll. :warning:

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: canary-3 -> kernel-pack-489 (image sha256:abc123).

sara_dev: thanks — attaching quick log snippet i grabbed from the smoke run:
```
[2026-03-17 08:12:34] INFO tokens/sec=15200 median=12.4ms p95=18.1ms p99=32.6ms
[2026-03-17 08:12:39] WARN tail-latency=34.2ms prefetch=on
```

sara_dev: bench command i'm running now:
```bash
python tools/bench.py \n  --model redwood-v1-small \n  --seq_len 2048 \n  --runs 10 \n  --batch 64 \n  --prefetch on,off \n  --trace-level perf
```

mike_ops: perfect. can you also include --kv-window=0.35 for one run to compare?

alex_infra: FYI i bumped kernel async_queue_depth to 128 on a staging node yesterday and saw p99 drop ~6ms across long sequences. worth trying alongside kv tweaks.

oliver_ml: if you run with kv-window=0.35, also monitor eviction rate metric `kv.evictions/s`. mine dropped from ~120/s -> ~18/s in the local test.

jen_reliability: will watch the canary. if OOMs show up again i'll open a high-priority incident and roll back. please tag me in the canary notes.

sara_dev: will run three variants: (A) prefetch=on, kv-window=0.2, async_qd=64; (B) prefetch=on, kv-window=0.35, async_qd=64; (C) prefetch=off, kv-window=0.35, async_qd=128. i'll post p50/p95/p99 + kv.evictions/s + alloc peaks.

mike_ops: thanks — ping when results are up, i'll queue a quick review of PR #489.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy succeeded: canary-3 -> kernel-pack-489 (status: success). duration: 2m 41s. :tada:

jen_reliability: nice. still keep SRE on standby until bench runs are green.

sara_dev: noted. will post full artifacts (bench CSV + flamegraph + perf traces) by 14:30 PST. thanks all. :wave:
